suppress.notes: False positive. spring-boot-devtools is matched to the CPEs of "Spring Tools" and "Spring Boot Tools", which are the Eclipse and VS Code editor plugins, not this library. CVE-2022-31691 is in those editor plugins (Spring Tools 4.16.0 and below, VS Code extensions 1.39.0 and below). Only these two CPEs are suppressed, so real Spring Boot CVEs (cpe vmware:spring_boot) are still reported. DevTools is also left out of the packaged application by Spring Boot's repackaging.

False positives (MEDIUM 5.3, below the CVSS 7 threshold, so they do not fail the build). opentelemetry-proto is matched to the generic "opentelemetry" CPE, which covers every language's SDK. CVE-2026-39882 and CVE-2026-41178 (Go), CVE-2026-40894 (.NET), CVE-2026-44967 (C++) and CVE-2026-54285 (JavaScript) are in those SDKs. This jar only holds the protocol's generated Java classes.
